show_instance_image: visualize instance segmentation masks and bounding boxes on an RGB image using detectron2
draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level prediction results with segmentation masks, boxes, and class labels on an image
add_annotated_frames: annotate ScanNet dataset frames with instance segmentation overlays and save as PNG images
run_scannet_frame_extraction: run the script to extract and annotate ScanNet validation frames with instance segmentation visualizations
review_show_instance_image: review the show_instance_image function that creates masks and bounding boxes from instance maps
